sources.snippet: Verity JE's AI chat uses a free Groq API key or a local model. Why can't I find the mod from the original videos? Because it never existed — the videos were scripted. The story of how a fictional mod became 17.7 million real downloads is covered in Is the Verity mod real? What Minecraft versions does the Verity mod support?
